assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished, restrained production UI concept for PlatformaMarket, a Russian-language B2B dental supplies marketplace. Use the supplied current browser screenshot as mandatory shell and design-system reference. Output one flat desktop screenshot at 1440x1000 CSS-pixel composition, no device frame, no perspective, no annotations outside UI. Preserve sidebar exactly 200px wide, existing logo 144x48 at x24 y6, top header 61px high starting x200, bell and employee avatar at top right. Main content starts x232 y85 with width1176 and 32px side insets. Do not enlarge or redesign the shell. Preserve role navigation and bottom Support/Settings. Remove only the developer black Next indicator. Manrope typography: header20px/600/28, card headings18px/600/22.5, body/labels14px/400/20, caption12px; never oversized display typography. Shared DmButton/DmInput/DmFluentDropdown visual grammar, controls min44px high radius8px, buttons14px semibold, input text14px using default shared size. Cards white radius12px border1px #D7E1DC padding24px, vertical gap24px. Canvas #F6F8F7, text #17201E and secondary #4F5E58, inputs border #83988D. Primary #007A59 white text; read-only field background #F0F4F2, soft selected #E4F3ED with #00543E. No new features, dashboards, illustrations, decorative hero, subscriptions, roles/team administration, personal editing/password controls, language/theme preferences or integrations. All example people/organizations are fictional, use example.invalid email. Exact legible Russian labels. The goal is a desired content composition grounded in existing APIs, not a redesign of standard controls. Page: CLINIC SETTINGS. Header "Настройки организации". Sidebar as reference: Главная, Каталог, Корзина, Заказы, Документы, Сообщения; Поддержка, selected Настройки at bottom. Three stacked compact cards, avoid excessive height: 1 "Данные организации" with two columns readonly "Юридическое название" = "ТОО «Демо Клиника»", "БИН" = "000000000001". 2 "Рабочие контакты": three columns "Контактное лицо" = "Тестовый сотрудник", "Телефон организации" = "+7 700 000 00 00", "Электронная почта организации" = "office@example.invalid". 3 "Адреса организации": equal legal-address and receiving-address columns, heading18px each, vertical labels above controls (cleaner than inline labels), city dropdown "Город" = "Алматы", address "Адрес" = "Тестовая улица, 1" or "Тестовая улица, 2", smaller "Почтовый индекс" = "050000". All fields44px. Below right aligned "Отмена" neutral outline and "Сохранить изменения" green primary44px; show an editable dirty example. No supplier warehouse/source tabs. Fit content before y940.
